reviews.name: Instrument
reviews.premise: A precision measuring device, not a trading floor. Graphite body, warm paper readout, one calibrated amber for the value that matters.
logo_ideas: A vernier caliper jaw closing on a gap — measurement, and the gap the platform actually reads
A single needle at rest off-centre, refusing to point at zero

reviews.name: Cold Read
reviews.premise: Forensic and dispassionate. A navy-black base rather than neutral black, cool light text, and an ice signal that never sells you anything.
logo_ideas: A confidence interval drawn as two brackets around an absent point estimate
An offset crosshair that deliberately misses centre

reviews.name: Nocturne
reviews.premise: Built for 6am in a dark room. An aubergine ink that is warmer on the eye than black, parchment text, sodium-lamp amber. Human hours, not server hours.
logo_ideas: A waning crescent formed by the negative space between two candle bodies
A horizon line with one mark below it, held rather than hidden
